mainEntity.name: How long does a rear-end collision case take to resolve?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a rear-end collision case varies greatly depending on factors such as the complexity of the injuries, the willingness of insurance companies to settle, and whether a lawsuit becomes necessary. Minor cases with clear liability and minimal injuries might resolve in a few months. More complex cases involving severe injuries or disputes over fault can take a year or more. An attorney can provide a more accurate timeline after reviewing the specifics of your situation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Case duration varies by injury severity, insurance cooperation, and need for a lawsuit. Minor cases might resolve in months, while complex ones can take over a year.
